Properties.Description:
This detection uses machine learning (ML) to identify anomalous Secure Shell (SSH) login activity, based on syslog data. Scenarios include:

* Impossible travel – when two successful login events occur from two locations that are impossible to reach within the timeframe of the two login events.
* Unexpected location – the location from where a successful login event occurred is suspicious. For example, the location has not been seen recently.

Allow two weeks after this alert is enabled for Azure Sentinel to build a profile of normal activity for your environment.

This detection requires a specific configuration of the data source. [Learn more](https://aka.ms/SentinelAnomalousSSHLoginDetection)
